content.value_statement: Teams often miss hardcoded strings, incomplete locale files, and RTL layout issues before release. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused i18n guidance plus a checker script for translation coverage.
actual_capabilities: Explains when an app should add i18n support.
Shows React, Next.js, Python gettext, and CSS logical property patterns.
Provides a Python checker for locale files and hardcoded strings.
Reviews locale key consistency across JSON translation files.
Highlights RTL layout practices and pre-release localization checks.
limitations: The checker uses regex heuristics and can miss dynamic strings or report harmless literals.
It scans only common locale paths and selected code file types.
It does not verify translation quality or cultural correctness.
RTL behavior still requires visual testing in target browsers.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Multilingual Release
use_cases.description: Review locale files, translation keys, date formats, and fallback behavior before a public launch.

use_cases.title: Check Translation Coverage
use_cases.description: Find missing locale files, unmatched keys, and hardcoded interface strings during sprint work.

use_cases.title: Plan RTL Support
use_cases.description: Identify layout practices that help Arabic, Hebrew, and other right-to-left interfaces render correctly.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic i18n Gaps
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feature for hardcoded user-facing strings, missing translation keys, and simple locale risks. Return a short prioritized list.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Locale Readiness Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a localization readiness checklist for this app. Include translation files, date and number formatting, fallback behavior, and RTL checks.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Translation File Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the locale structure for the supported languages. Identify missing namespaces, unmatched keys, and risky naming patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Advanced i18n Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced process design for a product team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an i18n quality workflow for this repository. Include automated checks, reviewer responsibilities, release gates, and manual validation steps.

output_examples.input: Review a React dashboard before adding Spanish and Arabic.
output: Several button labels and empty-state messages need translation keys.
Date and currency formatting should use locale-aware APIs.
Navigation spacing should use logical CSS properties before RTL testing.

output_examples.input: Check whether English, Turkish, and Arabic locale files are complete.
output: The review compares namespaces and reports missing key groups by language.
It separates missing translations from extra keys so teams can triage faster.
The final notes list follow-up tests for fallback language behavior.

best_practices: Keep translation keys stable and organized by feature area.
Use ICU messages for pluralization, variables, and complex grammar.
Run automated checks before release and validate critical flows manually.
anti_patterns: Concatenating translated fragments into full sentences.
Assuming every language uses left-to-right layout and similar text length.
Treating machine translation as final product copy without review.

faq.question: What does this skill help review?
faq.answer: It helps review hardcoded strings, locale file structure, missing keys, formatting rules, and RTL readiness.

faq.question: Does it translate text automatically?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on localization structure and checks, not translation quality or final copywriting.

faq.question: Which frameworks are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance includes React, Next.js, Python gettext, Vue-style patterns, and general locale file practices.

faq.question: Can the checker find every hardcoded string?
faq.answer: No. It uses regex patterns, so dynamic strings and unusual file structures may need manual review.

faq.question: Does it support RTL languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes RTL planning guidance, CSS logical property examples, and release checklist items.

faq.question: Is this useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill provides prompts, review guidance, and a local checker script for these coding assistants.
